capabilities: Sync Carbon Voice conversations and voice memos into the vault as Markdown notes
Generate linked People and Workspace stub notes for participants, senders and workspaces
Import AI summaries and AI artifacts with backlinks to their source messages
Embed an inline audio player or download audio files for offline playback
Configure sync scopes, history windows and background sync intervals
extras: Pre-1.0: README warns the note format and settings may change between versions and suggests a test vault or backup; releases are automated via GitHub Actions and published through the Obsidian community plugin store.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull voice conversations and voice memos from Carbon Voice into the vault as notes automatically.

relations.evidence: The plugin talks to the Carbon Voice API over the network

requires.name: Carbon Voice app (to generate the token)

summary: Syncs Carbon Voice conversations and voice memos into your vault as Markdown notes with transcripts, AI summaries, AI artifacts and audio playback.
